candidate.dispatch: Only first H global linear IDs write candidate; each writes BOTH rows. Never every thread with id%H<H. Old immutable; no publication claim.

exact_controls: asymmetric hand-computed oldest/middle/current taps with nonzero history
direct BF16 coefficients2^-25 times ones sum toHalf0x0002, narrowing coefficients gives0
zero coefficients outputzero but candidate must retain nonzero rawu
T1 copies BOTH rows; T2 replaces both; T3/32 only raw lasttwo
invalid: 9 operand/intermediate/output controls; invalid output words are retained by native consumer but never source equality gates

precision.coefficients: original finite BF16 widened exactly to F32; no Half narrowing
precision.domain: finite active inputs, all FP32 products/partial sums and final Half required; WIDE shares this admitted MAIN domain; no overflow cancellation rescue, clamp or generic FTZ
precision.main: p0=F32(oldest*c0), p1=F32(middle*c1), p2=F32(current*c2); s01=F32(p0+p1); z=F32(s01+p2); Half RNE(z); no initial+0, no FMA, no Half products
precision.signed_zero: exact state copies preserve sign bits; exact store witnesses include -0; general output comparisons numerical +/-0 equivalent; full/chunk same-profile output words compared exactly
precision.wide: same stored operands; separately evaluated FP64 p0,p1,p2; FP64(p0+p1) then FP64(s01+p2), one Half RNE; diagnostic only

scope: standalone NativeHalf raw causal depthwise3 and candidate recipe; no B*x/C*z fusion, resident state publication, graph, model, quality or performance
